turns.text: how does a group of cells decide to become an organ when no single cell is in charge
through local signaling constraints between neighbors; each cell follows simple rules and the tissue relaxes into a stable differentiated pattern, one fate chosen out of many possible
so the body plan is in the signaling not in any individual cell
exactly, the pattern is a property of the coupling between cells. isolate a cell and the pattern is gone. the organ is emergent, not located in any single cell
what makes a stem cell suddenly commit to one lineage
a signal crosses a threshold and the cell switches into a new stable gene-expression state, a new attractor. below threshold it stays plastic and absorbs the fluctuation
